book.name: Mataio
book.title: Mataio Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Mataioꞌa Mirihiro

content: Ioane Babatisoꞌa Iesu Ibi Ruhiniro
Eꞌe madaḡano Ioane Babatisoꞌa Iudea habaꞌano haba bohaꞌa aradu ꞌahige haramiro,
“Haḡaize sauꞌanonoꞌo ḡihuroꞌi, mazaḡa Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe madaḡa ꞌai haniteha.”
Peroveta vazeḡa Isaiaꞌa Ioane Babatiso moneo ꞌahige rae reiro,

content.text: “Vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa haba bohaꞌano huau ḡoereꞌohe, raenaꞌa,
ebu ani veize ibi mae dudunoꞌi.'”

content: Ioaneꞌa kamelo iguḡa hina haḡairoteꞌe dabuaḡa vidaro, zu mani ogaḡa miniḡa hina gabaꞌiḡano autiro, ebu fihore zu butu ꞌavoreḡa godaga aro.
Eꞌe madaḡano Ierusalemaonoꞌo, zu Iudea habaꞌa niduꞌaonoꞌo, zu Ioridana vuḡa habaꞌa niduꞌaonoꞌo vaze ḡehaḡaniꞌa Ioane vaḡe onamiro.
Ebu ze haḡaize sauꞌa rae furenadu Ioaneꞌa Ioridana vuḡano babatisoziro.

Farisea azaḡa zu Sadukea azaḡa ḡehaḡaniꞌa babatiso mouga radu Ioane vaḡe ariro. Ebu aneꞌa ze horozadu ziro, “Zaꞌe Zarama ubugaubuga! Iniuꞌa zae mazao, 'Badiꞌa zama ḡugiꞌanonoꞌo ferau muhinoꞌi,' rae reiro? Aꞌe mene idaḡa!
Rehano ibite haḡaize sau'anono'o ḡihuniroteꞌe haḡaiḡa izidi furenoꞌi.
Ebu ꞌahige rae ago zamaroꞌi, 'Emeꞌe Aberahamo mariga, eꞌanoꞌo Badiꞌaꞌa mene maḡunofiꞌuma.' Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, Badi'a'a hadi ꞌadi hina Aberahamo mariga haḡaoga zuni idaḡa.
Ḡiro 'ai ire taigano amahi tiro. Eꞌanoꞌo huga manoḡa mene iniꞌeteꞌe ireḡa niduꞌa'e udi higonadu ire rogao feuniꞌuma.

Zaeꞌa haḡaize sauꞌanonoꞌo ḡihuroga veize eḡeꞌa vu hina babatisoziꞌohe. Rehano eḡe ḡaruna ariteꞌe vazeḡa gigiꞌaḡaꞌe ufeta ḡihiꞌaḡa zu eḡe vitihoga. Eḡe'a ani tamaka odoheꞌeteꞌe tuḡureḡa vazeḡa rae rouga zuni mene idaḡa. Aniꞌe Vine Zaḡoḡa zu ire roga hina babatisoziꞌuma.
Maho hiriveꞌeteꞌe madaḡano,
vazeꞌa kari hina rouḡa tenadu maho huꞌiꞌohe, ebu iguḡa manoneꞌohe zu meba hare deheneꞌohe. Ebu hugaꞌe nuꞌonadu suaba zamaḡano tiꞌohe, rehano iguḡaꞌe mene vidauꞌeteꞌe ire rogao hufi haoneꞌohe.”
Iesuꞌa Babatiso Meiro
Eꞌe madaḡano Iesuꞌa Ioaneonoꞌo babatiso mouga radu Galilea habaꞌanonoꞌo Ioane vaḡe Ioridana vuḡa ariro.
Rehano Ioaneꞌa Iesu garariro zu niro, “Ḡaeꞌa eḡe babatisohifo. Nougaꞌahi ḡaꞌe eḡe vaḡe areha?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Izidiꞌe ꞌahige haḡaoꞌi. Eme Badiꞌaꞌa urateꞌeteꞌe haḡaiḡa duduḡa niduꞌa haḡae huniꞌuma.” ꞌOugadu Ioaneꞌa Iesu babatisoniro.
Iesuꞌa babatiso meiroteꞌe enogano vuonoꞌo gaba tiri onamiro. ꞌOugirotene, adureꞌa bohatanadu Iesuꞌe Vine Zaḡoḡaniꞌa Tubugo niniḡa teige ane mazao ovairoteꞌe horoniro.
Ebu ago ꞌahoganiꞌa adureonoꞌo ꞌahige rae reiro, “ꞌAdiꞌe eḡe zamarone ubude. Eꞌa ani mazao matu'e rudau'ohe.”
